Tessera — Al Ghurair Development

Officially announced on 21 September 2026. Location: Dubai South; exact plot address awaited.

2BR-plus and 3BR-plus homes, including duplex layouts, designed by Aires Mateus. Developer expects completion in 2028.

Starting AED price, payment plan, EOI and sales-opening date: not verified.

Broker value: family-sized, townhouse-inspired apartments to track ahead of confirmed commercial terms.

Confidence: high on the official announcement and product.

Pullman Residences & Offices Dubai Meydan — CITYVIEW / Accor

Officially announced on 29 September 2026 at FHS World. Location: Meydan Horizon, Dubai.

282 branded 1–4BR residences, alongside branded offices for sale. Planned opening: 2029; contractual handover unverified.

Starting AED price, payment plan, EOI and sales-opening date: not verified.

Broker value: a confirmed branded residential and office scheme to track before the commercial sales packs arrive.

Confidence: high on the announcement and product; sales terms awaited.
